hero.titleHtml: Refer a friend who’s an influencer
hero.subtitleHtml: Get up to $500 instantly, then 10% of everything they earn for 6 months.

blocks.html: The moment we confirm the introduction:
No need to wait for a campaign to start. Once we review the profile and confirm the tier, it’s yours.
On top of your instant bonus, you get 10% of the net profit generated by the person you introduced — for every campaign they run with us in the first 6 months.
This is separate from what the influencer earns. It doesn’t reduce their rate in any way. The better they perform, the more you earn — no cap, no extra steps.

items: Tell us who you know — name, platform, rough follower count.
We review the profile and confirm the tier.
We reach out and handle the conversation from there.
They join → your instant bonus is paid.
For the next 6 months, you get your share of every campaign they run. No extra work on your end.

cards.title: A few questions you might have

blocks.html:
Do I need to be an agency or manager to do this?
No. If you already work with us and you know someone who’d be a good fit, that’s enough.

What if I introduce someone we’ve already talked to?
Let us know when you submit it. If they’re already in conversation with our team, it won’t count as new. If we haven’t been in touch with them, it does.

Do I need to stay involved after the introduction?
No. Once you make the intro, we take it from there. You don’t need to manage anything — just tell us who to reach out to.

When do I get paid?
Instant bonus: as soon as the tier is confirmed. Your 10% share: on our regular payout schedule, for every campaign in the 6-month window.

Is there a limit on how many people I can introduce?
No. Every introduction gets its own bonus and its own 6-month share.
